\caption{Rise time by phase for the \texttt{nested\_sparse10} \textbf{pixel} conditions. Entry: the median over seeds of the first online sim step (in thousands) at which the run's rolling-30-episode rate for that phase crosses the threshold, with $[\min,\max]$ over seeds and $(\textrm{crossed}/\textrm{seeds})$. TRAINING RECORD: sampled actions on the policy's own training starts. `n/a' = no seed crossed inside budget. \textemdash\,(absent) = the learner's episode record does not carry that flag (RLPD logs no \texttt{farside}/\texttt{slide\_event}/\texttt{home}) -- absent, not zero. Budgets: 1\,M (ae/af), 2\,M (ag) online sim steps; \{RLPD\} 250k decisions $=$ 1\,M sim frames at action\_repeat 4. The \{dv3\} local seeds ran on the pop-os AVX2 GPU workstation; every other condition on the pax cluster. The ramp control uses \texttt{nested\_ramp}, not \texttt{nested\_sparse10}.}
